title: Roy Cohn, Robert Mapplethorpe and a Trump-Era Dilemma Over Free Speech
summary: When a respected biographer tried to use a Mapplethorpe photograph of Roy Cohn for a book cover, worries about the wrath of Mr. Cohn’s protégé, President Trump, intervened.
